name: Busybody
overview: Scripture warns against the behavior of busybodies, those who meddle in the affairs of others without cause. Leviticus instructs believers not to act as talebearers or stand against their neighbors, emphasizing the harm of spreading strife. Proverbs contrasts honor with foolishness, noting that fools are quick to involve themselves in conflict. The New Testament reinforces this in 2 Thessalonians, where some are rebuked for being disorderly and idle, described explicitly as busybodies, and are exhorted to work quietly and provide for themselves, reflecting a Christ-centered call to responsible and respectful living.
